name: Iris Watson
source:
Iris Watson is a child prodigy who lives with Sherlock Holmes. She holds a medical Ph.D. at the age of 10 and wrote the novel series The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Iris_Watson]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]

[SPOILER]
She is the daughter of Klint van Zieks and at the same time the niece of Barok van Zieks.
